This documentation describes the conception, development and evaluation of *Follow the Gold*, a single-page scrollytelling narrative that asks **who actually bought the gold in 2022 — the year inflation peaked at its highest level in forty years**. The live product is at <https://gold-flows.streamlit.app/>; the source for both the app and this documentation is at <https://github.com/VDSS-FS26-DS25A/follow-the-gold>.

The argument the app makes — that the 2022 gold-import surge is sovereign de-dollarisation, not consumer inflation hedging — emerged from a Phase 1 diagnosis of an earlier dashboard-style draft. That memo (`diagnosis.md`) and the beat-by-beat narrative design that followed it (`narrative_design.md`) are linked from the sidebar under *Process Memos*.

![The vizualization product development process](pics/vizproductprocess.png){#fig-vizprocess}

The methodological procedure of this work follows the process model shown in @fig-vizprocess, which is based on the concepts on data product development outlined in @DoemerKempf2022_1000150238 and the [data science project-template](https://github.com/phonosync/dataviz-project-template) on github.

It comprises the following four main phases with the corresponding documentation artefacts:

* **Project Understanding** &rarr; [Project Charta](project_charta.qmd): Context analysis, stakeholder and user analysis (based on the Value Proposition Canvas), formulation of objectives, success criteria, constraints and the visualization concept.
* **Data Acquisition and Exploration** &rarr; [Data Report](data_report.qmd): Identification and acquisition of relevant data sources, followed by exploratory data analysis to understand data quality and structure.
* **Visual Encoding and Design** &rarr; [Visualization Design Report](viz_design_report.qmd): Documentation of the data-to-visual mapping, layout and composition, interaction design, visual style and the resulting prototype(s).
* **Evaluation** &rarr; [Evaluation Report](evaluation.qmd): Assessment of the developed prototype based on success criteria outlined in the project charta, evaluation of stakeholder feedback, checkpoint decision and, if applicable, gathering additional requirements and planning of the deployment.
* **Deployment** &rarr; [Deployment Report](deployment.qmd): Description of the software architecture and deployment process, as well as the integration of the visualization product into the target environment and processes.
